notes.title: The Line TD v1.2
notes.content:
- Fixed a UI bugged that made the cursor invisible after unplugging a controller.
- Now also supports controllers with screens that are not 1920x1080.

notes.title: -- Update 1.1--
notes.content:
- Controller Support added
- Now Auto Detects Controller
- Change UI depending on controller used
